method.precision: W8A8_DYNAMIC, int8 weights, bf16 weight scales for kernel, bf16 hidden states
method.chain: dynamic per-token quant -> fused gate/up grouped matmul -> SwiGLU -> dynamic activation quant -> down grouped matmul -> restore row order
method.weights: fused [gate; up] followed by down, processed to transposed production layout with npu_format_cast
method.formal_timing: only final synchronization inside a block; segment profile is separate

scope_limits: No cross-rank dispatch/combine, HCCL transfer or waiting.
No router, attention or full-service TTFT/TPOT measurement.
Both expert banks are pre-resident; the rotation test is not a cold-weight test.
The real-top8 vector is an observed expert workload, not a full per-rank vector composed of all 16 experts.

cache_context.context: both 8-expert banks pre-resident; no artificial cache clear
cache_context.interpretation: same-shape repeated weights versus round-robin between two resident banks
